entities.summary: Jamie Vaughn Westbrook is an American professional baseball outfielder and second baseman who is a free agent. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Boston Red Sox. He was drafted by the Arizona Diamondbacks in the fifth round of the 2013 MLB draft. He played for the United States national baseball team in the 2020 Summer Olympics.
